change_log.value: Structured Error Response and Rejection Handling

GPTR-F-001-S94.title: Schema and Allowlist Contract Definition
GPTR-F-001-S94.description: Define strict request schema and explicit allowlist contract covering collections, fields, operators, and query shapes permitted for GPTReader requests, enforced via Pydantic models.

GPTR-F-001-S95.title: Core Allowlist Validation Engine
GPTR-F-001-S95.description: Implement deterministic validation logic that enforces allowlist constraints against incoming requests, rejecting any disallowed collections, fields, operators, or nested query patterns before execution.

GPTR-F-001-S96.title: Structured Error Response and Rejection Handling
GPTR-F-001-S96.description: Design and implement standardized error responses for rejected requests, ensuring no sensitive data leakage and consistent messaging for invalid schema, unauthorized access, or malformed queries.
